en.headline: Hong Kong Port Area at Huanggang established; Security Secretary inspects facilities
en.dek: The Hong Kong Port Area came under HKSAR jurisdiction from midnight; Tang Ping-keung inspected the co-location facilities and chaired a cross-departmental meeting on readiness.
body: The Hong Kong Port Area at the redeveloped Huanggang Port was formally established at midnight on Friday and is now under the jurisdiction of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region in accordance with local laws.

Secretary for Security Tang Ping-keung visited the Hong Kong Port Area in the joint inspection building on Friday afternoon. He inspected facilities including the public transport interchange, passenger clearance floors, vehicle clearance floors and the clearance hall for accompanying personnel, as well as the progress of installing co-location self-service channels, manual counters and joint one-stop vehicle lanes.

Tang then chaired a cross-departmental working group meeting with representatives from the Transport and Logistics Bureau, Transport Department, Highways Department, Architectural Services Department, Electrical and Mechanical Services Department, Government Property Agency, Police Force, Fire Services Department, Immigration Department, Customs and Excise Department and Department of Health. The meeting reviewed project progress, system testing and emergency drill arrangements.

The Government said it will continue close co-operation with Shenzhen authorities to advance system testing, operations and emergency drills. The formal public opening date will be decided jointly by the Hong Kong and Guangdong governments once both sides confirm that the facilities are ready for safe and smooth operation, and will be announced in due course.

zh.headline: 皇崗口岸港方口岸區今日零時成立 鄧炳強視察並主持跨部門會議
zh.dek: 港方口岸區由今日零時起由特區依法管轄；保安局局長鄧炳強下午視察聯檢大樓設施，並主持跨部門會議推進開通前準備工作。
body: 重建後的皇崗口岸港方口岸區於今日（7月31日）零時正式成立，由香港特別行政區依照本地法律實施管轄。
保安局局長鄧炳強今日下午前赴皇崗口岸聯檢大樓港方口岸區視察，巡視公共運輸交匯處、出入境旅檢樓層、出入境車檢樓層及隨車人員驗放廳，實地檢視合作查驗自助通道、人工櫃枱及「聯合一站式」車道等設施安裝進度。
其後，鄧炳強與運輸及物流局、運輸署、路政署、建築署、機電工程署、政府產業署、警務處、消防處、入境事務處、香港海關及衞生署等相關部門代表召開跨部門工作小組會議，討論工程進度、測試情況及演練安排，確保口岸設施及運作周全穩妥。
特區政府表示，將繼續與深圳方面保持緊密合作，有序推進系統測試、運作及應急演練。待雙方確認具備安全、暢順運作的條件後，粵港兩地政府將敲定正式開通日期，並適時向公眾公布。
